statement: Every two-power nonstable dihedral family member and all its actual intermediates satisfy both all-prime cusp assertions
notes: Registered after full independent root, DE and PBC proof/source/exact-certificate audits PASS. For C_m:v²=w^(2m)−6w^m+1, m a two-power, the actual degree2m map has dihedral group and four cusp indicesm/2. The ramified nilpotent tree theorem gives potential good Jacobian; a primitive cyclotomic special-Tate dimension argument plus DS/RH, finite-flat smooth fixed-point lifting and a rooted-tree genus contradiction excludes every ordinary Prym inductively. Four actual principal divisors kill cusp differences bym. The Frattini inertia and actual norm maps give the same hypotheses on every intermediate, so A41/A42 yield full all-prime fixed groups and A59 all normalizers. The plus-six family is obtained after a finite extension. Universal A45 remains Open; no classification of arbitrary dihedral closures is asserted.
